title: View
description: What a renderer draws: where each component is, and highlight layers decided by the engine. A renderer draws the overlays as given (coloured triangles and lines in world space) and needs no other logic. Output of GET /api/view, and the `view` of every state.

revision.description: Increases with every change to the scene.

nodePairs.description: The components that intersect, as a set: one entry per pair of components with at least one intersecting triangle pair between them (a and b the same component for triangles of one component), ordered by a, then b.

pairs.description: The intersecting triangle pairs between them.

label.description: For a renderer's list of layers.

role.description: What the layer means; a renderer may restyle by role.

items.description: triangles only: the triangles drawn, in the order of `positions`.

positions.description: World-space points: 3 per triangle (triangles) or 2 per segment (lines).
